subject: 2-years postdoc and 1 PhD available to apply SCR models on large carnivores datasets

messages.author: 7942411909f80d82
messages.subject: 2-years postdoc and 1 PhD available to apply SCR models on large carnivores datasets
parts:
Dear all,

A 2-years postdoc and 1 PhD position are available in our group (NMBU, Ås, Norway) to apply SCR models on datasets from wolves, bears and wolverines in Scandinavia.

(Not sure this is relevant in this list, but it may be of interest to some you)

 

(Application deadline 1 August 2019)

PhD: https://tinyurl.com/y523t6ws 

Postdoc: https://tinyurl.com/y5l86e3g  (Solid statistical and mathematical background required)

 

WildMap is an international collaboration of a team of researchers from Norway (Norwegian University of Life Sciences and Norwegian Institute for Nature Research), Sweden (Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences), France (Olivier Gimenez, University of Montpellier), and the USA (Perry De Valpine, University of California Berkeley and Andy Royle, USGS Patuxent Wildlife Research Center).

 

For further information, please contact Richard Bischof  <richard...@nmbu.no>

 

Kind regards,

 

Cyril Milleret
